newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 683-685 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 683-685 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 683-685 per dollar, virtually unchanged from the morning's 680-685 as dollar supply and demand were balanced in a lively interbank trade, dealers said.
"The lev traded range-bound between 680-685 as large final clients were bidding for dollars in the morning while supply also was relatively large," one dealer said.
Dollar supply came mainly from final clients as banks were reluctant to pare forex positions amid the current political unrest, traders said.

News on Wednesday that the ruling Socialists and the opposition have inched towards talks aimed at solving the political crisis had a little impact on the market, which was rife with expectations of a further lev fall, traders said.
"The lev will be under pressure as long as prospects of fresh foreign funding remain unclear. Any bid for a large dollar volume can push the lev down," another dealer said.

Buffeted by ten days of street protests and strike threats, the ruling Socialist party gave some way to opposition calls for early elections by suggesting polls before the end of this year -- a year ahead of schedule. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
